system.description: A ring is made of delicate silver threads forged in a pattern of thorny brambles with a single blood-red ruby set in the center. Anyone who puts on this cursed ring is suffers the effects of a sigil of Lyssa incantation for as long as the ring is worn (@Check[save:will]{Will save}, DC 28, negates). When the ring is removed, the victim must make a second @Check[save:will|dc:28]{Will save (DC 28)} or suffer the effects for an additional 16 minutes.
